title: Mankind vs. The Rock: an unlikely champion
summary: Mankind fights the corporate champion through a series of increasingly unusual title matches. His first championship victory becomes a key Attitude Era moment.

chapters.title: Mankind wins his first WWF championship
chapters.result: Mankind defeats The Rock after Austin intervenes.
chapters.context: Television airdate. The underdog overcomes The Corporation; the match was taped earlier.

chapters.title: Rock regains the title
chapters.result: The Rock defeats Mankind in an I Quit Match.
chapters.context: The title changes hands in the rivalry’s violent rematch.

chapters.title: Mankind wins in an empty arena
chapters.result: Mankind defeats The Rock to regain the championship.
chapters.context: Broadcast during Super Bowl halftime; the fight ends with Mankind pinning Rock beneath a forklift load.
